description: Defines a specification class for filtering and paginating catalog items in an e-commerce application.

classes.name: CatalogFilterPaginatedSpecification
classes.description: A specification class that filters catalog items based on optional brand and type IDs, and supports pagination.

methods.name: CatalogFilterPaginatedSpecification
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the specification with skip, take, brandId, and typeId parameters, applies filtering logic, and supports pagination.
